# P34.29 — M5 return_pass.py generator + projection fixes (landings, verify in CI)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-MEM-010** (extends — owner P34.9; this row:
"RETURN PASS MUST equal its generated form") · **Base:**
`r11/P34.28-readout-authorship-and-signed-gate-check` (stacked; merge
after P34.28) · **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/234_P34.29__return-pass-generator-and-projection-fixes.md`
(manifest row 234 — Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A; depends SEED-02,
P34.28) · **Gate:** no pause · **Live stage:** none · **Production
mutations:** none · **CI config changed: yes** — the `docs` job gains a
step "RETURN PASS generated-region check (return_pass.py)"; it also runs
inside `make docs-check` (`docs-check-returnpass`), the same composition
two existing steps already use (disclosed per H2 §4.7).

## Why

RETURN PASS was hand-kept: the `### RETURN PASS — current` table and the
CURRENT STATE `returnPass:` key could silently drift from the obligation
events, the dispositions and each other (A3 NEW-2/NEW-3 made exactly that
visible). The projection claimed landings it never checked (F-28) and a
header still asserted the shadow-mode cutover "→ P32.8". This row makes
the table generated, the key derived, the homes rule executable, and the
projection honest about where owed work lands.

## What this ships

- **`docs/build/tools/record_policy/return_pass.toml`** —
  `return-pass-map/1`, the one committed source for the region: `[meta]`
  carries the verbatim heading/preamble/postamble (including the SEED-16
  provenance and the SEED-17 T5 γ re-keying note, preserved — nothing
  silently overwritten), 19 `[[row]]` entries across three kinds
  (`obligation`, `leg`, `operator`), and 16 `[[row.legs]]` entries
  carrying each queued OM-19 leg's id, window (earliest + excluded
  hours), go id (or `pre-authorised: S5-3`), re-run line and `live:`
  dependants.
- **`docs/build/tools/return_pass.py`** (`generate` / `check`, stdlib
  only, `--root` for fixtures) — renders the whole `### RETURN PASS —
  current` region (the `history.policy` `exempt` generated region —
  regenerated, never hand-edited; every other LEDGER region only gains
  lines) and the `returnPass:` value as the sorted ticket column. The
  heading is now canonical — the generator's own name plus the map's
  recorded seed provenance replaces the per-run wall-clock stamp, so
  `generate` is deterministic (OM-04: no `date -u` needed to reproduce).
  `check` enforces V6: committed region == generated output
  byte-for-byte; `returnPass:` == the sorted ticket cells (`—` rows
  excluded); map↔cell coherence (each row's `obligations` list equals
  the D-ids its cell names; each leg's window/go/re-run stays inside the
  row's cells; no obligation in two rows); every map-named obligation
  still owed; every owed `live-return-pass(...)` disposition named by
  exactly one row; every other owed obligation in exactly one home —
  RETURN PASS, a manifest row, a later-phase/wontfix/other disposition,
  or a recorded `owner:`/`trigger:`/`due:` watch bound. Reports the
  evaluated count; zero-of-non-empty is vacuous (exit 3, SIG-ENG-042).
- **Projection fixes (`current_projection.py`)** — an owed obligation's
  `landing` now derives from its S1b disposition (RETURN PASS row key,
  resolved `ticket(<unit>)` chain row, or the recorded later-phase /
  merged-into / waiver ref) with a `landing_source` label; the
  event-head landing stands only where the dispositions are silent and
  for terminal obligations (whose landing *is* the recorded outcome).
  The stale "→ P32.8" header text is removed. CURRENT.md shows the
  committed RETURN PASS table verbatim (compact columns; spills to a
  link-out page rather than dropping rows if the view ever exceeds the
  20 KiB budget). `return_pass.toml`, `UNIVERSE_DISPOSED.csv` and
  `round11_plan.csv` join the hashed input manifest, so a stale map or
  disposition edit fails `verify`.
- **CI** — `docs-check-returnpass` joins the `docs-check` composite;
  `return_pass.py check` is also a named step in the `docs` job next to
  the existing `current_projection.py verify` step (already wired via
  `docs-check-projection` since P34.9).
- **Tests** — `test_return_pass.py` (17 tests, throwaway fixture trees
  via `--root`): byte-for-byte drift, key/table disagreement, unsorted
  key, no-home, two-homes (in-table + ticket()), live-return-pass with
  no row, leg render + leg field escaping its cells, duplicate map rows,
  stale (terminal) rows, unresolvable `ticket(<unit>)`, watch homes,
  vacuous exit, natural ticket order — plus a pinned `check` on the real
  tree (the invariant, never today's values; OM-15).
